newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine raw steel output up 14.7 pct in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Argentine raw steel output up 14.7 pct in 1996.

text.p: Argentina produced 4.09 million tonnes of raw steel in 1996, up 14.7 percent from 1995, the Steel Industry Association said Monday.

Primary iron output rose 17.0 percent in the period to 3.39 million tonnes, hot laminate production rose 7.4 percent to 3.96 million tonnes and cold laminate output increased by 4.6 percent to to 1.22 million tonnes.
Output levels were historical records, due to big investments to modernize the Argentine steel industry, the association said.
December 1996 output of raw steel was 328,800 tonnes, which was 24.0 percent above production in December 1995, but 10.5 percent lower than output levels in November.
Primary iron output was 285,000 tonnes, which was 32.6 percent more than the December 1995 but 3.4 percent lower than in November.

Hot laminate production, at 338,700 tonnes, was 18.8 percent above the same month in 1995, but 7.8 percent less than in November. Cold laminate production was 109,500 tonnes, which was 11.8 percent above December 1995 and 3.1 percent higher than in November.
